description: This Kotlin file defines a fragment for an Android TV application that displays rows of ongoing sports matches grouped by league. It manages UI elements, data observation from a repository, image loading with SVG support, and handles user interactions like clicking on a match to view details.

classes.name: MainTvFragment
classes.description: An Android TV fragment that displays groups of matches by league, updates in real time, and handles click events to show match details.

classes.name: MatchCardPresenter
classes.description: A custom Presenter for displaying match cards with images and text, optimized for TV focus navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment's UI, image loader, and starts observing matches.

methods.name: observeMatches
methods.description: Collects real-time match data from the repository and triggers row-building.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Creates UI rows grouped by league, displaying each match as a card.
